external_method_inputs.source: OpenAI CoinRun / Quantifying Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
external_method_inputs.transferable_rule: Generalization evidence requires evaluation on instances not used during development/training; unseen-level testing is distinct from training-set performance.
Procedural generation is useful because it can create distinct train/test instance sets; diversity and unseen test levels are explicit benchmark dimensions.
IID unseen-instance holdout and OOD feature-axis holdout are different claims and should be represented separately.
Keep meta-test material mutually exclusive from material available during optimization and keep primary metric logic outside the mutable solution surface.

architecture_observation.current_strength: WP800 strongly binds exact fixture identity, hidden evaluator state, public-interface digest, run ancestry and producer-only object construction. WP803, WP804 and WP806 reuse that boundary instead of creating competing evaluator authority; WP805 binds distinct source/target ids and public digests.
architecture_observation.gap: The current contract does not mechanically distinguish an opaque object named heldout from a fixture family demonstrably disjoint from development/calibration material. holdout_set_id is an identifier, not a split proof. Producer-lineage hardening proves authorized object construction, not statistical/generator-family independence.
architecture_observation.cross_consumer_effect: Because WP802-WP806 depend on WP800, repairing split provenance centrally is lower-duplication and gives every downstream held-out benchmark the same evidence semantics. WP805 additionally needs an explicit relation between source and target split manifests.

counterhypotheses.statement: A separate producer pipeline may already freeze and withhold benchmark fixtures so WP800 only needs to bind that producer receipt rather than implement set logic itself.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Search current producer/manifests for a machine-verifiable development-vs-holdout disjointness receipt bound into every fixture. If present and exact, reuse it instead of duplicating split authority.

counterhypotheses.statement: For many WP800 uses, unseen IID instances are the correct falsifier; requiring OOD feature-family separation universally would change the question rather than improve it.
counterhypotheses.disposition: SUPPORTED_AS_DESIGN_CONSTRAINT: preserve separate IID_INSTANCE and OOD_AXIS regimes rather than replacing IID holdout with OOD.

counterhypotheses.statement: evidence_source_family, donor_path_family and method_family might be enough to define structural disjointness.
counterhypotheses.disposition: REJECT_AS_GENERAL_RULE: those fields describe evidence/research provenance and can correlate with generation structure, but they are not a typed generator/distribution contract. They may be retained as auxiliary axes, not silently reinterpreted.

proposed_minimal_contract.name: WP800_HOLDOUT_SPLIT_PROVENANCE/v1
proposed_minimal_contract.placement: single canonical WP800 evaluator/fixture boundary; downstream benchmarks consume the same bound identity

objects.name: SplitManifest
objects.public_surface: only an opaque split identity/digest when needed; no hidden held-out cases, axis values or evaluator truth become SUT input

objects.name: SplitRelation
objects.purpose: deterministically classify two bound manifests and prove the declared non-overlap relation
objects.fail_closed: missing manifests, unknown generator identity, missing declared OOD axis, or unverifiable set relation => UNPROVEN

fixture_binding: MicroWorldFixture full digest binds exact SplitManifest digest and evaluator contract digest
RunDescriptor inherits the bound split identity automatically from the exact fixture
existing holdout_set_id remains compatibility/display identity but cannot alone mint held-out credit
cross_fixture_binding: WP805 TransferCase binds a SplitRelation digest for source->target and declares required regime
other cross-fixture comparisons may reuse the same relation rather than ad-hoc label inequality
required_negative_tests: different holdout_set_id but overlapping case manifest => reject held-out credit
different fixture_id with same case identity => reject held-out credit
IID_INSTANCE relation accepts disjoint cases under same generator family
OOD_AXIS relation additionally requires declared held-out axis/value disjointness
same generator family is not itself an OOD proof
different evidence_source_family/method_family is not itself a generator-distribution proof
metric/evaluator contract digest drift between matched evaluations => fail closed
held-out manifest contents are not exposed through ObservationView/public fixture digest payload

runtime_efficiency.reason: hash/set-manifest validation at fixture construction or evaluation setup; no heavyweight Procgen/DiscoGen runtime is imported and no per-step model work is added
runtime_efficiency.reuse: one central contract improves WP802-WP807 benchmark semantics

promotion_policy.next_exact_gate: E3 source-semantic counterexample: show that two individually valid current WP800 fixtures can carry distinct fixture_id/holdout_set_id while sharing the same generation/provenance family and no contract rejects their use as independently held-out. Then hand the minimal negative regression to Trigger4 only if reproduced.
